scope.definition: Currently compiled event IDs; supporting old cards are context.

summary: Rejected: repeated outcomes assign earlier choices and failures the player may never have made, and two cards duplicate their existing ambient pool’s shared wiring. All fifteen cards were read; off-campus ambient filtering was checked in the director and is not reported as a defect.

issues.problem: The second setup and later outcomes remember the tubs turning the player’s robes pink last time. The first successful charm keeps the robes clean and the hand-washing route never risks discoloration. The remembered failure is not earned by either history.
issues.fix: Condition the pink-robe memory on an actual discoloration outcome, or describe the tubs’ reputation without assigning that failure to the player.

issues.problem: The second honest outcome gives the same true answer as last time, the third calls honesty a habit, and the third lie says the player lies again. The sequence advances after either choice, so switching sides produces false memories of earlier truth or deception.
issues.fix: Make each answer stand on its own, or read the actual earlier choice when describing the habit.

issues.problem: The third Hop on outcome grants Lore, but only describes going shoeless and calling it a fashion. The earlier variants explicitly earn their Lore by notes or reading; that learning disappears from the sticky variant while its reward remains.
issues.fix: Show the lecture or reading in the third outcome too, or use a scene-supported gain for that variant.

issues.problem: These two cards copy the ambient group’s class/repeat/weight setup instead of joining the world_more_routine pool already declared in their file. Their special repeat values can be intentional overrides, but the shared wiring is still duplicated.
issues.fix: Join world_more_routine and retain the different repeat values and their own gates/cast/slot as explicit overrides.
